cases.title: ATM debited Rs 10,000 but no cash dispensed
cases.summary: Claimant withdrew Rs 10,000 from a bank ATM. The machine showed an error and printed a failed-transaction slip, but the amount was debited from the account. Complaint to the bank 20 days ago got no refund.

reasons: Single small money claim of 10000 rupees
Bank statement and failed-transaction slip attached
No near deadline or safety risk

cases.title: Demolition notice, 48 hours left, stay sought
cases.summary: A tenant family received a municipal demolition notice for their shop-house with only 48 hours to vacate. They ask for an urgent stay order. Two children and an elderly parent live in the premises.

reasons: Demolition in 48 hours, harm is irreversible
Stay order requested
Children and an elderly person live in the premises

cases.title: Assault causing serious injury outside a market
cases.summary: Complainant says two men attacked him with a rod outside a market. He has a fractured arm and a medical report. CCTV footage exists. Police have registered the matter.

reasons: Criminal offence with serious injury
Several accused and CCTV evidence to verify
Needs a court, not an AI draft

cases.title: Cheque of Rs 45,000 returned unpaid
cases.summary: Claimant gave goods worth Rs 45,000 to a shop owner and received a cheque. The bank returned it for insufficient funds. A written demand was sent 15 days ago with no reply.

reasons: One clear amount and one respondent
Cheque return memo and demand letter attached
Respondent version not yet received

cases.title: Landlord not returning Rs 30,000 security deposit
cases.summary: Tenant vacated after 11 months and handed over the keys with a photo record. Landlord refuses to return the deposit, claiming unspecified damages and showing no bills.

reasons: Small deposit refund dispute
Rental agreement and handover photos attached
Landlord has shown no repair bills

cases.title: Freelancer unpaid invoice of Rs 60,000
cases.summary: A freelance designer delivered a full brand kit. The client approved it on email but has not paid the Rs 60,000 invoice for 60 days and now says the work was never ordered.

reasons: Single invoice dispute, one respondent
Email approval exists as evidence
Respondent denies ordering the work

cases.title: Defective phone, seller refuses refund of Rs 22,000
cases.summary: Phone stopped charging 9 days after purchase. Seller refuses refund saying it is physical damage. Claimant has the invoice, a service-centre report of a battery fault, and photos of the phone.

reasons: Clear consumer refund claim
Service-centre report supports a battery fault
Warranty period is still running

cases.title: Ancestral land share dispute among five heirs
cases.summary: Five siblings dispute the division of ancestral farmland after their father died without a will. Two have sold portions to outsiders. Title papers conflict and a neighbour also claims a boundary strip.

reasons: Disputed title with conflicting papers
Five heirs plus outside buyers and a neighbour
High value, needs a court
